posts.title: CATAPHRANT: Lessons learned
posts.description: This post is long-overdue. Below is a scattershot of various topics I’ve ruminated upon during and since running CATAPHRANT this past June. A lot of these thoughts are CATAPHRANT/VANGUARD specific ( see here for the campaign details ), but probably half of them, if not more, are broadly applicable. posts.title: Prince Agapetos
posts.description: You are Prince Agapetos of Paralía, and the kingdom is your right. How dare your brother call himself a king? He is a deceiver, and your father’s blood was not yet cold when he cast you out and claimed his false throne. Knowing you alone saw the true events of that fateful night, he rallied the populace against you, spewing lies and slander—all he is capable of, with his horrible shrunken tongue.
